# Continent 8 Technologies appoints Mike Small as CEO; Founder Michael Tobin transitions to Chairman

 3rd August 2026 

Continent 8 Technologies, a leading provider of cutting-edge managed IT solutions designed for the global iGaming and online sports betting industry, today announced the appointment of Mike Small as Chief Executive Officer, effective 15 July 2026. Founder Michael Tobin will transition to the role of Chairman following 28 years as CEO.
